summary.intent: Orchestrate parallel background agents working on multiple branches (trail 157 trust and agents, t155-156-detect, a release run on main) in the caliper project, and shepherd them to PRs.
summary.outcome: The trail 157 worker hit its 200-turn limit during the final gate on branch 3 (feat/prop-level-confidence), so it was resumed via SendMessage to finish the TypeScript package tests, confirm all three branches are committed and signed, and send a full report. No PRs were opened yet.

repo: Caliper uses per-agent git worktrees under .claude/worktrees/agent-<id> with branches named worktree-agent-<id>.
The final gate for a branch includes TypeScript package tests when files under packages/ changed.
Commits on the trail branches are expected to be signed.
PRs #289 and #290 must be merged by the user to unblock oracle/three-tools-report.
workflow: Background agents have a 200-turn limit; when hit they return partial output and can be resumed with SendMessage to the same task-id.
A task-notification can fire multiple times for the same agent, each time it stops with no live background children.
Partial-result notices should be treated as incomplete; the orchestrator should resume rather than treat the work as done.
Push, link and open PRs only after the worker's full report is in.
